post.description: Register a new user using a valid referral code. For Company, Sector, Industry and Country, either the existing ID or the corresponding 'other_' value must be provided. After successful registration, a welcome/account-created email is sent to the user's email address. Email delivery failure does not prevent successful account creation. The returned authentication token creates a login session valid for 30 days. The session uses sliding expiration, meaning each authenticated activity resets the session expiry to 30 days from the latest activity. If there is no authenticated activity for 30 consecutive days, the session expires and the user must log in again.

company_name.description: Company ID. Either company_name or other_company must be provided.

other_country.description: Country name when country ID is not available.

201.description: User registered successfully. A welcome email is also triggered to the registered email address. The returned authentication session is valid for 30 days and uses sliding expiration. Authenticated activity resets the session expiry to 30 days from the latest activity.

post.description: Authenticate the user using email or username and password. If two-factor authentication is enabled, the API returns a temporary two_factor_token and requires the user to complete 2FA using the /api/user/2fa/login endpoint. After successful authentication, the user's login session is valid for 30 days. The 30-day session expiry uses a sliding expiration policy: each authenticated activity resets the session expiry to 30 days from the latest activity. If the user has no authenticated activity for 30 consecutive days, the session expires and the user must log in again.

200.description: Login successful or two-factor authentication required. A successful authenticated session is valid for 30 days and follows a sliding expiration policy.

loginSuccess.description: The user receives an authentication token and a login session that remains valid for 30 days from the latest authenticated activity.

twoFactorRequired.description: The user must complete 2FA using the temporary two_factor_token before an authenticated 30-day login session is created.

500.description: Internal server error or unable to send login OTP
